changes.new_text: Термины и определения Сайт — содержимое интернет-страниц, расположенных в сети интернет по адресу какого-либо из доменов, управляемых Исполнителем, включая, но не ограничивая: [LINK] , [LINK] , [LINK] , которое используется Соискателем в соответствии с настоящим Соглашением как напрямую по соответствующим адресам, так и посредством иных сайтов и приложений, в том числе, приложения Исполнителя. Регистрация на Сайте — процедура создания аккаунта на Сайте и получения Соискателем учетной информации. Регистрация производится на основании данных, добровольно и осознанно предоставляемых Соискателем Сайту как напрямую, через регистрационные формы Сайта (в т.ч. через мобильное приложение Исполнителя), так и посредством иных сайтов и приложений. Регистрация и/или авторизация на Сайте возможна с использованием VK ID, который является инструментом Экосистемы VK. Экосистема VK — общее пространство взаимодействия пользователей, сервисов и специализированных инструментов, призванных повысить удобство использования привычных для пользователей сервисов. Пользовательское соглашение Экосистемы VK размещено в открытом доступе в сети Интернет по адресу [LINK] . Регистрация и/или авторизация на Сайте посредством VK ID, означает согласие с Пользовательским соглашение Экосистемы VK, размещенным по адресу в сети Интернет [LINK] и Политикой конфиденциальности Экосистемы VK, размещенной по адресу в сети [LINK] . Соискатель — посетитель Сайта, прошедший регистрацию на Сайте с целью поиска работы и иных видов занятости, либо использующий Сайт также для поиска работы и иных видов занятости, но без регистрации на Сайте. База данных HeadHunter — совокупность резюме Соискателей, находящихся в сети интернет по адресу домена [LINK] . Учетная информация Соискателя — логин и пароль для входа на защищенные страницы Сайта. В качестве логина используется указываемый Соискателем при регистрации на Сайте адрес электронной почты или номер телефона, поддерживающий получение коротких текстовых сообщений (SMS). Факт регистрации электронной почты Соискателя на Сайте в качестве учетной информации (в качестве логина) для работы на Сайте (авторизации на Сайте) не является информацией, конфиденциальность которой Исполнитель обязан обеспечивать. Резюме — документ, содержащий персональные данные Соискателя, включающий информацию о фамилии и имени, адресе электронной почты, образовании, описании мест работы, а также прочих данных, относящихся к поиску работы и иных видов занятости. Видеорезюме — видеозапись, созданная Соискателем с использованием функционала Сайта, содержащая персональные данные Соискателя, относящиеся к поиску работу и иных видов занятости. Клиент — любое, зарегистрированное на одном из Сайтов, управляемых Исполнителем, юридическое, физическое лицо, или юридические лица, определенные администрацией Сайта и использующие одну регистрацию работодателя на сайте, получившие уникальные логин и пароль для входа на защищенные страницы (регистрацию работодателя) соответствующего Сайта Исполнителя. Анонимный пользователь Сайта — юридическое или физическое лицо, не зарегистрированное ни на одном из Сайтов Исполнителя или зарегистрированное только на одном из них, но использующее доступные для него сервисы Сайта(-ов), на котором оно не зарегистрировано на момент использования такого Сайта. Приложение — программное обеспечение (программа для ЭВМ) Исполнителя для функционирования на мобильных устройствах с операционной системой iOS и Android, и имеющее функционал, предоставляющий Соискателю, если он использует такое программное обеспечение, возможность поиска работы и иных видов данных посредством использования данных, сервисов и функционала, содержащихся на сайте [LINK] .

changes.old_text: Subject of the Agreement The Contractor shall provide the Jobseeker with the possibility to post CV at the Web-site, to search vacancies published at the Web-site and to create responses to them. In compliance with Federal Law dated 27.07.2006 No. 152-FZ «On personal data» the Jobseeker shall, for the purposes set forth in Clause 2.3 hereof, give consent to the Contractor to performance of the following actions with all personal data provided by the Jobseeker when registering on the Web-Site or subsequently on the Web-Site, including in the respective CV: dissemination (only in respect of CV or data from CV), collection, systematization, accumulation, storage, specification (updating or change), use, provision, access, blocking, destruction, search and collection of information on the Jobseeker from public sources of information based on the data specified in the CV. The purpose of processing the personal data of the Jobseeker includes the following: Identification of the Jobseeker as a party to this Agreement and personalization of the provided services of the Web-Site; Employment with potential employers and conducting a preliminary interview for employment with potential employers; Sending notifications, requests and information related to the use of services of the Web-Site, contacting in any other way for the execution of this Agreement, processing requests and reports from the Jobseeker; Improvement of quality of the services of the Web-Site, convenience of their use, development of new services of the Web-Site; Targeting of advertisement materials; Sending any information messages, including advertisement; Conducting statistical and other studies; Performance by the Contractor of its obligations under this Agreement. The term of placement of personal data in the form of CV (term of provision of consent as per Clause 2.2 hereof) is not limited and is determined independently by the owner of personal data (Jobseeker). Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as established between the Contractor and the Jobseeker of agency relations, partnership, joint venture, personal hire or any other relations not directly stipulated in this Agreement. When the Jobseeker gives response to any vacancy, the potential employer of this vacancy may ask questions, results of answers to which shall be kept by this employer and shall not be communicated to the Jobseeker or there may come an offer from a potential employer for the Jobseeker to pass any test from such a potential employer on the Web-Site. At that, no questions of the employer and answers to them by the Jobseeker may be understood as the sole criteria of employment. Answers of the Jobseeker to the questions of the potential employer are confidential. All responsibility for the confidentiality treatment of the answers of the Jobseeker shall be borne by the respective potential employer. In the case of passing the test from a potential employer by the Jobseeker, a report based on the results shall be generated and shall be available for viewing only to this potential employer. At the same time, the content of such a report shall not be provided to the Jobseeker. The Jobseeker has the right to refuse to pass any test on the Web-Site from a potential employer. Answers of the Jobseeker to the questions and the content of the test report from a potential employer shall be confidential. All liability for confidentiality of the answers of the Jobseeker and the content of the test report from a potential employer shall be borne by the respective potential employer. For performance with the CV of actions specified in Clause 2.2. hereof, the Contractor shall not pay any fees and/or remunerations in favor of the Jobseeker. The Contractor shall not bear liability for confidentiality and/or actions of third parties with the personal data of the Jobseeker, including those placed by the Jobseeker on the Web-site in the form of CV, as a result of establishment by the Jobseeker of certain CV visibility settings (Clause 3.1.3). For the purposes of performance of obligations hereunder and achievement of the objective of processing of the personal data of the Jobseeker (Clause 2.3 hereof), the Jobseeker gives his/her consent to the Contractor to distribution and transfer of the personal data of the Jobseeker provided by the Jobseeker in the form of CV to any third parties located at the territory of any foreign state (right of the Contractor to cross-border transfer of personal data of the Jobseeker to any third parties). Placement by the Jobseeker of personal data on the Web-site in the form of CV may be carried out both directly by the Jobseeker through completion of a special form on the Web-site and automatically — through provision by the Jobseeker of consent to the Web-site (and other web-sites) to obtain the personal data by program means or otherwise for making the CV from the other web-site (s) where the personal data of the Jobseeker are located with his/her consent. In case of transfer of personal data from another web-site, the Jobseeker shall be identified by e-mail and phone number provided when registering on the Web-site. In case of automatic making of CV (Clause 2.10), after the Web-site has made the draft CV by program means, the Jobseeker may either confirm placement of such CV on the Web-site or refuse to place it. By entering into this Agreement, the Jobseeker gives to the Contractor his/her consent for the Contractor to place the order for the processing of the personal data of the Jobseeker placed in the form of CV on the Web-Site provided by the Jobseeker when registering on the Web-Site or subsequently on the Web-Site, to any third party on the basis of the respective agreement concluded with such a person. The Jobseeker hereby grants his/her consent to receive messages from the Contractor via telecommunication networks, namely: calls, messaging via mobile radiotelephone networks (SMS), as well as mailings made through instant messaging systems via Internet (Whatsapp/Viber and other messengers) according to the contact information provided by the Jobseeker in his/her CV on the Web-Site, or when registering on the Web-Site or subsequently on the Web-Site. The Jobseeker gives his/her consent to the following messages mentioned above in this clause (including mailings and calls) from the Contractor: informing about the services of the Contractor, including the services of the Web-Site; responses (invitations) of potential employers, recruitment agencies and recruiters in response to the CV posted on the Web-Site by the Jobseeker or the response of the Jobseeker to the vacancy posted by someone, if such mailings are made through the Web-Site; other information, including advertisement. The Jobseeker hereby grants his/her consent to receive information messages from the Contractor via social media, including «Vkontakte» and «Odnoklassniki» and through instant messaging systems via Internet (Whatsapp/Viber and other messengers), including messages: related to the possible subsequent employment of the Jobseeker with a potential employer, about vacancies that could be potentially interesting or suitable for the Jobseeker. The Jobseeker hereby gives his/her consent to processing of personal data on current connection in terms of statistic data: user identifier assigned by the Web-site; pages visited; number of pages visited; information on browsing the web-site pages; duration of user session; access points (external web-sites from which the user goes to the Web-site using the link); exit points (links on the Web-site using which the user goes to external web-sites); country of the user; region of the user; time zone set on the user’s device; provider of the user; browser of the user; user searches, including searches for a user-defined location; canvas fingerprint; available browser fonts; installed browser plug-ins; browser WebGL parameters; type of available media devices in the browser; availability of ActiveX; list of supported languages on the user’s device; architecture of the processor of the user’s device; operating system of the user; screen parameters (definition, color depth, parameters of page placement on the screen); information on use of automation means when accessing the Web-site; not personalized data on data input parameters, mouse movement parameters, used combinations of buttons without saving the data entered by the user. Such data are collected both by the mechanisms of the Web-Site itself and by the mechanisms of third-party Internet services, including, without limitation: LiveIntenet; Rambler.top100; ComScore; TopMail.ru; Google Analytics; Yandex.Metric; Group-IB Secure Portal. Such data are collected for the purpose of formation of statistics of Web-site use and assurance of Web-site security. Data on use of ports on the users’ devices may be collected in respect of the registered users of the Web-site in order to detect suspicious activity and protect personal areas of the users. The Contractor may change the list of third-party Internet services used without notification of the Jobseeker. The third-party Internet services shall provide for storage of received data on own servers, the Contractor shall not bear liability for location of servers of third-party Internet services. changes.old_text: Validity of the Agreement, Amendments This Agreement shall be valid from the moment of its acceptance by the Jobseeker. The Jobseeker, by entering into this Agreement, shall represent and warrant that he has reached the age at which the Jobseeker under current Russian legislation has the legal right to enter into this Agreement, and the Jobseeker has the necessary legal capacity to enter into this Agreement. The Contractor may, at any time at its own discretion and without prior agreement with the Jobseeker, introduce amendments into this Agreement. In this case, amendments and supplements shall come into force from the moment of their publication on the Web-site. Use by the Jobseeker of the Web-site (and exercise by the Jobseeker of rights and obligations stipulated by this Agreement) after any amendments to this Agreement shall mean consent of the Jobseeker to such amendments and/or supplements. If the Jobseeker does not agree to use the Web-site after introduction of amendments into this Agreement by the Contractor and/or to comply with this Agreement after the amendments, the Jobseeker shall stop using the Web-site and may terminate this Agreement by sending the respective notice to the Contractor. The Contractor may at any time, including if the Jobseeker violates the terms of this Agreement, terminate this Agreement unilaterally without any prior notice to the Jobseeker and any compensation in this regard. In case of termination of this Agreement, the Contractor shall delete the Accounting Data of the Jobseeker, CV posted by the Jobseeker on the Web-site and other materials and information. The text of this Agreement is presented on the Web-site in two languages: in Russian on the current Russian version of the Web-site; in English on the current English version of the Web-site. In case of discrepancies between the Russian and English versions of this Agreement, the Parties shall be guided by the Russian version of this Agreement.
